decisions.reason: The area elastic sports flooring system builds on the firm's established wood flooring and surface know-how, and in-house R&D supports learning from early results, so it is kept.
Although mobile arena floors are somewhat more complex, the system still builds on established wood-floor know-how, and the firm's own R&D helps it absorb and apply new information, so it is kept.
Like product B, this mobile sports floor system builds on established wood-floor know-how, and the firm's in-house R&D enables it to interpret results and improve, so it is kept.
The chevron hardwood parquet is very close to the firm's core premium wood flooring business, so the firm can readily interpret results and learn from them, and it is kept.
